definitions.pass: one pass = every set once, in the order given; each (pass, set) is scored on its own (pipeline.audit + eval.read_accuracy + eval.run_eval.score, as bench_tiered), so passes of the same set should give the same F1, key fields wrong and docs for a person
definitions.stop: --repeat N: N passes. --duration-min M: no new document is handed out once M minutes of read wall clock have passed; documents already handed out (and their retries) are finished. The last pass of a timed run is usually partial (partial: true): scored on the documents it reached, and left out of the stability comparison
definitions.docs_per_hour: documents read / read wall clock of the whole run (all workers loaded -> last document back; reloads after crashes included). per_device counts the documents read by the workers on that card over the same wall clock
definitions.per_hour: crashes_per_hour, restarts_per_hour = count x 3600 / read wall clock (s). A restart follows a crash or a reader error (restarts_after_reader_error)
definitions.docs_not_read_reader_failure: documents sent to a person because the reader failed twice on them (READ_REVIEW, reason reader_crash / reader_error / no_reader)
definitions.wh_per_1000_docs: per card: xpu-smi energy counter (end - start) when it behaves as a running counter, else mean sampled power x read wall clock; / documents read on that card x 1000
definitions.utilisation: GPU utilisation % per card from xpu-smi dump metric 0 (header column whose name holds 'util' and 'gpu' but not 'mem'; column and raw_header recorded), over the read wall clock: mean, p50 / p95 (1 % bins), frac_ge_90 = share of 1-second samples at or above 90 %; null with the raw header when the column is missing
definitions.samples: power / memory / utilisation summaries are exact running sums over every sample; the full 1-second series is in the side CSV (side_files), not in this file; the in-RAM copy used for per-pass windows is thinned (in_ram_samples_kept_every)
definitions.supervisor: a worker that dies is restarted and its document retried once; a second failure sends it to a person; logs in this file are capped at logs_capped_at entries, counts are not

notes: OCR runs on the CPU inside each worker, so K workers also share the CPU
K=2: hard: scoring differs between complete passes (see passes)
K=2: blind3: scoring differs between complete passes (see passes)
K=2: main: scoring differs between complete passes (see passes)
